Backup & Recovery Assessment

A fixed-scope review of backup and recovery across your sites and critical systems, including a live restore test, turned into a prioritized improvement plan for IT and management.

Discuss This Service ↗What’s included ↓
Typical duration
2–3 weeks
Format
Fixed scope, agreed in writing
Includes
A live restore test of up to three critical systems
Result
A management report and an improvement roadmap

WHO IT IS FOR

Built for teams
like yours.

  • Medium enterprises with servers, an ERP, or file shares across one or more sites
  • IT teams that run backups but have never tested a full restore
  • Companies facing questions about backup from auditors, banks, insurers, or regulators

WHAT’S INCLUDED

What the engagement covers

The exact scope is confirmed in writing before work begins, based on your systems, priorities, and existing work.

01

Critical systems inventory

Identify the systems the business cannot run without, such as ERP, finance, file shares, and databases, with their owners and sites.

02

Current backup review

What is backed up, how often, where copies are kept, how long they are retained, and who checks them.

03

Live restore test

Restore up to three critical systems into an isolated environment and measure how long recovery actually takes.

04

Ransomware exposure

Check whether backups could be deleted or encrypted by an attacker using stolen administrator credentials.

05

Recovery objective gap

Compare how much data you could lose, and how long you could be down, with what the business can accept.

06

Report and roadmap

A prioritized plan presented to IT and management, with clear options for improvement.

WHAT YOU RECEIVE

Deliverables your
team can use.

  • Critical systems and backup inventory
  • Restore test results with measured recovery times
  • Ransomware exposure findings
  • Recovery objective gap analysis
  • Management report and improvement roadmap
01

Facts, not assumptions

You know which systems can be restored, and how long it really takes.

02

Clear priorities

The gaps that matter most to the business are fixed first.

03

A case for budget

Management sees the risk and the options in business terms.

HOW IT WORKS

A clear path
from start to finish.

Every stage has a defined objective, named owners, and documented outputs.

  1. 01

    Discover

    Week 1: inventory critical systems and sites, and review the current backup setup and policies.

  2. 02

    Test

    Week 2: restore critical systems in an isolated environment and measure recovery.

  3. 03

    Report

    Week 3: present findings, gaps, and the roadmap to IT and management.

QUESTIONS

Common questions
about this service.

Something else on your mind? Ask our team ↗

Will the restore test affect our live systems?

No. Restores are made into an isolated environment, never over production, at a time agreed with your IT team.

Do you need administrator access?

We work with your IT team using temporary access that is agreed in writing, logged, and removed when the assessment ends.

What happens after the assessment?

You can carry out the roadmap with your own team or with us. Many organizations continue with Managed Backup & Recovery or Disaster Recovery as a Service.
